svg.text: AI-ASSISTED PROJECT DELIVERY FRAMEWORK — TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE
Artifact-Based Context Management · Prompt Chaining · Human Review Gates · Session Isolation
GOVERNANCE LAYER — PM maintains authority at every checkpoint · AI generates · PM validates · PM decides · No AI output advances without PM acceptance
Session isolation: no persistent state between runs
Agent reads input + prompt · Produces 3 structured output files
No inferred items presented as fact
Inputs: orig. doc + all 3 Module 1 files (4 files total)
OPEN items carried forward — not resolved by engine
Agent reads 4 files together · Produces 4 delivery artifacts
Confirms OPEN items not silently resolved
CONTEXT MANAGEMENT LAYER — Artifact-Based (No Session Memory)
HOW CONTEXT IS PRESERVED ACROSS SESSIONS
Each module runs in a separate AI session. The agent has no persistent memory between sessions.
Project context is re-established at the start of each session by re-issuing all relevant artifact files as structured inputs. The file system is the system of record.
Unresolved OPEN items are never dropped. They are carried forward in artifact files and re-issued as part of
Module 2 inputs, then carried again into task notes in the project plan. PM resolves — AI does not.
Each run starts clean from structured input.

CONTINUOUS PM SUPERVISION ACROSS ALL PHASES
PM documents: context degradation events · fabrication incidents · stale assumption drift · hallucinated decisions · guardrail effectiveness · prompt corrections applied
PM ROLE: Supervisor · Instruction Architect · Governance Owner · Drift Detector · Correction Authority · Report Author
